AI_decoder: NuttX, parallel requested, step16, window128, depth1
AMR: User-supplied ESP-IDF firmware, MR475, DTX off, single task
host_tasks: Frozen input preparation/resampling, USB/log collection, waveform metrics; no host codec simulation used as measured result
AMR_alignment_calibration: Once on fixed2s run1, lag constrained to 0..400 at8k; applied unchanged to every clip/run. This 5ms waveform offset is NOT full algorithm or first-audio latency.
quality_preprocessing: Both waveforms DC removed; no output gain fit or per-clip external lag search. PESQ and STOI retain their standard internal processing.
radio_comparison: AMR baseline has no LoRa transport or speaker path. No AMR RF first-audio/loss/continuous-playback claim.
memory_warning: AI decoder arena peak, AMR source-calculated preallocated buffers, and free heap are different scopes; no memory reduction ratio is computed.
